title: Quarantine undecodable-video tdarr sample fixtures
summary: Adds decodable-video verification to the TDARR sample fixture pipeline so header-only/undecodable upstream samples are quarantined out of generated test libraries instead of being linked in and producing guaranteed encode failures. The materializer now honours a 'video_decodable' inventory column and skips any sample marked 'false'; the (gitignored) downloader gained an ffprobe decodability check, a 'video_decodable' column, and a --verify-only mode to re-probe an existing pool without re-downloading.
reason: Companion to MP-CHANGE-2026-0609-001. A full sweep of the tdarr sample pool (2316 files) found 124 samples whose container header declares a video stream with zero decodable packets (e.g. sample__2160__libx265__alac__30s__video.mkv -> tdarr-0698, plus many *.mp2 and libx265-in-wmv stress combos). These are faithfully downloaded (size+sha256 match) but cannot be encoded, so they only manufacture failures when materialized into the matrix library.
behavior_before: materialize_tdarr_test_library linked every inventory sample whose file existed, including undecodable-video samples, which then failed downstream encode. The downloader verified only byte size and sha256, with no decodability signal.
behavior_after: TdarrSample carries a video_decodable field read from the inventory; materialize() partitions out samples where video_decodable=='false' (case/space-insensitive), skips them, and reports quarantined_samples in its summary. Absent/empty/'true'/'n/a'/'unknown' values are treated as include (backward compatible with pre-column inventories). The downloader computes video_decodable via a bounded ffprobe first-packet read on download and via a new --verify-only pass, and records undecodable_video_files in its summary.
manual_validation: Full pool sweep via bundled ffprobe: 124 of 2316 files have undecodable video (35 declare a video stream with zero packets; 89 are fully rejected by ffprobe with 'Invalid data', mostly *.mp2/*.wmv stress muxes)

download_tdarr_samples.py --verify-only run to populate inventory video_decodable column (gitignored E: asset pool; inventory.csv/json backed up to *.pre-decodable.bak first). Final counts: 124 false, 165 n/a (audio-only), 2027 true, 0 unknown (= 2316)
End-to-end on the real inventory: load_inventory + partition_quarantined_samples -> 2192 included, 124 quarantined
operator_validation_required: Rebuild the matrix test library (materialize --rebuild) and confirm summary quarantined_samples == count of undecodable pool samples and those sources are absent from source/Movies + source/TV.
rollback_plan: Revert the video_decodable field + partition_quarantined_samples/is_quarantined_sample additions in materialize_tdarr_test_library.py and the two new tests; restore the gitignored inventory from inventory.csv/json.pre-decodable.bak and revert the downloader edits (find_ffprobe/probe_video_decodable/annotate_decodability/verify_existing/--verify-only/--ffprobe and the video_decodable column).
